The itinerary includes a climb up Caana, a tall Mayan structure in Belize. On the return journey, there are stops at Rio Frio Cave and the natural Rio On Pools in the Mountain Pine Ridge reserve. There is time here to swim and relax.

After the excursion, return to the lodge.

In the evening, we recommend relaxing and getting ready for Brazil's biggest celebration: the famous Rio de Janeiro Carnival!

You will be picked up at your hotel and taken to the Sambadrome, the venue for one of the country's most spectacular carnival performances.

You will become part of this enormous celebration and watch performances by some of Brazil's finest samba schools, whose members dance and sing in magnificent, brightly colored costumes. The energy and atmosphere of Carnival are everywhere, making it an unforgettable experience.

Join the spectators, sing along, move to the beat of the drums, cheer for each samba school and share in the performers' excitement. This incredible show continues through the night, and you can stay at the celebration for as long as you like.

If you get tired, a return transfer to your hotel can be arranged after any samba school's performance.

## Walking Through the Historic Quarter

We will introduce you to historic [Casco Viejo](/panama/place/casco-viejo/) on a four-hour walking tour. English-speaking guides accompany the participants, while our team coordinates the walk, transfers and a restaurant stop.

On the seven-day corporate trip, we combine the walk with lunch at Mahalo Cocina y Jardín and a tasting of Panamanian coffee. Lunch and the tasting are priced as separate services; when you book the excursion, we will agree on their details and timing with you.

This cultural excursion takes you to an Emberá community in the Chagres River area. The journey in a traditional canoe passes through tropical forest.

In the community, you learn about the Emberá way of life, their traditions and their relationship with the surrounding natural environment. During the visit, hosts explain traditional music and dance, display the work of local craftspeople, offer dishes from their cuisine and share their knowledge of medicinal plants.

After lunch and the cultural program, tour P036 continues with a transfer to Gamboa. The specific host community is not named in the Word document and is confirmed when booking.
